title: Divine Omnipotence

canonical_node.axiom: God can actualize any coherent state of affairs; omnipotence is the capacity to actualize all possibilities, limited only by coherence itself.
definitions: Omnipotence: The capacity to actualize any coherent state of affairs.
Coherent state: A state of affairs that does not entail a logical contradiction.
Actualization: The bringing of a potential state into actuality, as performed by the Terminal Observer.
Terminal Observer: God, who observes and thereby actualizes potentials.
derivation: From G01, God is the Terminal Observer who actualizes potentials.
Potentials exist as coherent possibilities (quantum superposition).
Actualization of a potential requires an actualizer; God is that actualizer.
Therefore, God can actualize any coherent potential (G2.1).
Contradictions (P  not P) are not coherent states and thus not potentialities.
Since actualization requires a potential, God cannot actualize contradictions (G2.2).
This is not a limit on power but a definitional boundary of coherence.
God's power is defined as the ability to actualize potentials (G2.3).
Nothing external to God constrains Him, as all else depends on God (G01).
canonical_node.action: The system should treat God as capable of actualizing any coherent state, and should reject any claim that God lacks power due to external constraints or logical impossibilities.
boundary: Does not claim God can actualize logical contradictions.
Does not claim God's power is arbitrary or brute force.
Does not address the problem of evil as a limitation of power.
Does not claim God intervenes in every event; only that He has the capacity.
test: Check that any proposed limit on God's power is either a logical contradiction or an external constraint that depends on God.
Verify that the definition of omnipotence is consistent with the coherence boundary.
Ensure that the derivation from G01 is logically valid.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a formal definition of omnipotence as actualization of coherent states, enabling logical analysis of divine power.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the grounding of actuality in God as Terminal Observer from G01.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this axiom, the concept of divine power becomes undefined or arbitrary, weakening the coherence of the theological framework.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Retain as a theological axiom with clear boundary conditions; do not treat as empirically verified.

overstatement_risks: Claiming that omnipotence is proven by physics when it is a theological assertion.
Treating the coherence limit as a physical law rather than a logical boundary.
Implying that God's non-intervention is evidence of choice rather than incapacity without additional premises.
kill_conditions: If a coherent state is found that God cannot actualize, the axiom fails.
If an external constraint on God is demonstrated that does not depend on God, the axiom fails.
If the derivation from G01 is shown to be logically invalid.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the coherence boundary in a proof assistant to verify logical consistency.

plain_summary: This document defines divine omnipotence as the ability to actualize any coherent state, excluding logical contradictions. It argues against weak God theologies, deism, and process theology by claiming that any apparent limitation is either a choice or a logical impossibility. The axiom is coherent within the framework but lacks empirical proof.
